notes: *Far from* kept whole as the מִן's one rendering, headed on the relational word on the model of rule 24's *more than*; leaving *Far* added was the competing reading.
*Even* is `added`: it stands before a phrase no object marker and no conjunction reaches (rules 14, 16, 30), and the italic corroborates (rule 7).
Both צִדְקוֹת units head on *righteous*, *acts* being the supplied generic the ASV never writes alone for צְדָקָה (rule 31); מַשְׁאַבִּים heads on *drawing* by the same subtraction.
Both marginal alternatives read and set aside (rule 38).
